why_not_bounded: MD-008 cannot be a live-wired patch because NO real diagram painter exists anywhere in the workspace, and the live consumer explicitly discards the rendered frame. The only trait impls of DiagramPainter are the fail-closed sentinel NoDiagramPainter (crates/cli/src/native_mermaid.rs:451, returns MermaidFailure::Unavailable) and the #[test]-only StubPainter (:1084, inside mod tests). The live painter `paint_fence_block` builds MermaidRenderer::without_painter (:2299) which always yields MermaidOutcome::Fallback and paints the plain code block. Additionally the boundary type DiagramFrameSize (:414-420) carries GEOMETRY ONLY ('Glyph cells are the painter's business (and are not modelled here)'), so even injecting a painter would not produce painted cells: the live consumer drops Rendered frames by design (:2308-2313). No mermaid/merman rendering crate is present in any Cargo.toml (rg mermaid|merman|latex in Cargo.toml -> none).

missing_seams.required_producer: A real Mermaid engine: parser for each supported kind (flowchart/gantt/gitgraph/sequence/state/timeline) plus a canvas/box-drawing @ cell renderer, exposed as a DiagramPainter impl. Upstream delegates to packages/merman (a full TS engine, canvas.ts, per-kind parsers).

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live consumer is hard-coded to without_painter and its Rendered arm only debug_asserts (a frame has geometry but no cells). To paint an actual diagram the consumer must both receive a painter and consume glyph cells.
missing_seams.required_producer: A glyph-cell carrier (or cell-returning painter API) and a live render path that copies those cells into transcript rows; plus wiring of the real painter.
